# SportConnect — Backend Implementation

Spring Boot 3.x (Java 17) backend implementing the full API contract: JWT auth, Event CRUD with geo-filtering, SSE notifications, and user profile endpoints, backed by MongoDB Atlas.

spring:
  application:
    name: sportconnect-backend
  profiles:
    active: ${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:dev}
  data:

      uri: ${MONGODB_URI:mongodb://localhost:27017/sportconnect}
  jackson:
    default-property-inclusion: non_null

server:
  port: ${SERVER_PORT:8080}

app:
  jwt:
    secret: ${JWT_SECRET:sportconnect-dev-secret-key-change-me-32bytes-min!!}
    expiration-seconds: ${JWT_EXPIRATION_SECONDS:3600}
  cors:
    allowed-origins: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:http://localhost:5173}
  rate-limit:
    auth-capacity: ${RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_CAPACITY:10}
    auth-refill-minutes: ${RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_REFILL_MINUTES:1}

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health

logging:
  level:
    root: INFO
    com.sportconnect: DEBUG

package com.sportconnect.model;

import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.geo.GeoJsonPoint;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Indexed;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapping.Document;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

@Data
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Document(collection = "users")
public class User {

    @Id
    private String id;

    @Indexed(unique = true)
    private String email;

    private String passwordHash;

    private String displayName;

    private List<String> preferredSports = new ArrayList<>();

    private GeoJsonPoint homeLocation;

    private Instant createdAt;

    private Instant updatedAt;
}
```

package com.sportconnect.repository;

import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface UserRepository extends MongoRepository<User, String> {

    Optional<User> findByEmail(String email);

    boolean existsByEmail(String email);

    List<User> findByPreferredSportsContaining(String sport);
}

package com.sportconnect.repository;

import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.repository.MongoRepository;

import java.time.Instant;

public interface EventRepository extends MongoRepository<Event, String> {

    List<Event> findByOrganizerId(String organizerId);

    List<Event> findByParticipantIdsContaining(String userId);

    List<Event> findByStatusAndStartTimeBetweenAndReminderSentFalse(

}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/dto/event/EventCreateRequest.java
package com.sportconnect.dto.event;

import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Max;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Min;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Size;
import lombok.Data;

import java.time.Instant;

@Data
public class EventCreateRequest {

    @NotNull(message = "sportType is required")
    private SportType sportType;

    @NotBlank(message = "title is required")
    @Size(max = 200, message = "title must be at most 200 characters")
    private String title;

    @Size(max = 2000, message = "description must be at most 2000 characters")
    private String description;

    @NotNull(message = "location is required")
    @Valid
    private LocationDTO location;

    @NotBlank(message = "addressLabel is required")
    @Size(max = 300)
    private String addressLabel;

    @NotNull(message = "startTime is required")
    private Instant startTime;

    @Min(value = 15, message = "durationMinutes must be at least 15")
    @Max(value = 600, message = "durationMinutes must be at most 600")
    private int durationMinutes;

    @Min(value = 1, message = "maxParticipants must be at least 1")
    @Max(value = 200, message = "maxParticipants must be at most 200")
    private int maxParticipants;
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java
package com.sportconnect.exception;

import com.sportconnect.dto.ErrorResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

import java.time.Instant;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex,
                                                           HttpServletRequest request) {
        String message = ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream()
                .findFirst()
                .map(f -> "field '" + f.getField() + "' " + f.getDefaultMessage())
                .orElse("Validation failed");
        return build(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, message, request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(ResourceNotFoundException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleNotFound(ResourceNotFoundException ex,
                                                         HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(ForbiddenException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleForbidden(ForbiddenException ex,
                                                          HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN, ex.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(ConflictException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleConflict(ConflictException ex,
                                                         HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ex.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(BadRequestException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleBadRequest(BadRequestException ex,
                                                           HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ex.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(UnauthorizedException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleUnauthorized(UnauthorizedException ex,
                                                             HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex.getMessage(), request);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleGeneric(Exception ex,
                                                        HttpServletRequest request) {
        return build(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "An unexpected error occurred", request);
    }

    private ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> build(HttpStatus status, String message, HttpServletRequest request) {
        ErrorResponse body = new ErrorResponse(
                Instant.now().toString(),
                status.value(),
                status.getReasonPhrase(),
                message,
                request.getRequestURI()
        );
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body);
    }
}
```

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/util/ErrorResponseUtil.java
package com.sportconnect.util;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.sportconnect.dto.ErrorResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;

public final class ErrorResponseUtil {

    private ErrorResponseUtil() {
    }

    public static void write(ObjectMapper mapper, HttpServletResponse response, int status,
                              String error, String message, String path) throws IOException {
        response.setStatus(status);
        response.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE);
        ErrorResponse body = new ErrorResponse(Instant.now().toString(), status, error, message, path);
        response.getWriter().write(mapper.writeValueAsString(body));
    }
}
```

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/security/SecurityUtils.java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import com.sportconnect.exception.UnauthorizedException;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AnonymousAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;

import java.util.Optional;

public final class SecurityUtils {

    private SecurityUtils() {
    }

    public static Optional<String> getCurrentUserId() {
        Authentication auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
        if (auth == null || !auth.isAuthenticated() || auth instanceof AnonymousAuthenticationToken) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Object principal = auth.getPrincipal();
        if (principal instanceof String userId) {
            return Optional.of(userId);
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    public static String requireCurrentUserId() {
        return getCurrentUserId().orElseThrow(() -> new UnauthorizedException("Authentication required"));
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/security/JwtService.java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;

@Component
public class JwtService {

    private final SecretKey key;
    private final long expirationSeconds;

    public JwtService(@Value("${app.jwt.secret}") String secret,
                       @Value("${app.jwt.expiration-seconds}") long expirationSeconds) {
        this.key = Jwts.SIG.HS256.key().build();
        // Use the configured secret deterministically instead of a random key
        this.key = Keys(secret);
        this.expirationSeconds = expirationSeconds;
    }

    private SecretKey Keys(String secret) {
        byte[] bytes = secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(
                bytes.length >= 32 ? bytes : padTo32Bytes(bytes)
        );
    }

    private byte[] padTo32Bytes(byte[] input) {
        byte[] padded = new byte[32];
        System.arraycopy(input, 0, padded, 0, Math.min(input.length, 32));
        return padded;
    }

    public String generateToken(String userId, String email) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        return Jwts.builder()
                .subject(userId)
                .claim("email", email)
                .issuedAt(Date.from(now))
                .expiration(Date.from(now.plusSeconds(expirationSeconds)))
                .signWith(key, Jwts.SIG.HS256)
                .compact();
    }

    public Claims parseToken(String token) throws JwtException {
        return Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(key)
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)
                .getPayload();
    }

    public long getExpirationSeconds() {
        return expirationSeconds;
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/security/JwtAuthenticationFilter.java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Parses the Authorization header if present and, when valid, sets an authenticated
 * SecurityContext. Never rejects the request itself — invalid/expired/missing tokens
 * simply result in an anonymous context, letting downstream authorization rules decide.
 */
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private final JwtService jwtService;

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,
                                     HttpServletResponse response,
                                     FilterChain filterChain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String header = request.getHeader(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);

        if (header != null && header.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            String token = header.substring(7).trim();
            try {
                Claims claims = jwtService.parseToken(token);
                String userId = claims.getSubject();

                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authToken = new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
                        userId, null, List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_USER")));
                authToken.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request));
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(authToken);
            } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
                SecurityContextHolder.clearContext();
            }
        }

        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/security/RateLimitingFilter.java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.sportconnect.util.ErrorResponseUtil;
import io.github.bucket4j.Bandwidth;
import io.github.bucket4j.Bucket;
import io.github.bucket4j.Refill;
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.Map;

/**
 * IP-keyed in-memory rate limiter applied only to /api/auth/** endpoints.
 */
@Component
public class RateLimitingFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {

    private final Map<String, Bucket> buckets = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final int capacity;
    private final int refillMinutes;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    public RateLimitingFilter(@Value("${app.rate-limit.auth-capacity}") int capacity,
                               @Value("${app.rate-limit.auth-refill-minutes}") int refillMinutes,
                               ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.refillMinutes = refillMinutes;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest request) {
        return !request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/auth/");
    }

    @Override
    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,
                                     HttpServletResponse response,
                                     FilterChain filterChain) throws ServletException, IOException {
        String key = resolveClientIp(request);
        Bucket bucket = buckets.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> newBucket());

        if (bucket.tryConsume(1)) {
            filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
        } else {
            ErrorResponseUtil.write(objectMapper, response, HttpServletResponse.SC_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                    "Too Many Requests", "Rate limit exceeded, please try again later", request.getRequestURI());
        }
    }

    private Bucket newBucket() {
        Bandwidth limit = Bandwidth.classic(capacity, Refill.greedy(capacity, Duration.ofMinutes(refillMinutes)));
        return Bucket.builder().addLimit(limit).build();
    }

    private String resolveClientIp(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String xff = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For");
        if (xff != null && !xff.isBlank()) {
            return xff.split(",")[0].trim();
        }
        return request.getRemoteAddr();
    }
}

@Component

package com.sportconnect.config;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

@Configuration
public class CorsConfig {

    @Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins}")
    private String allowedOrigins;

    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
        CorsConfiguration configuration = new CorsConfiguration();
        configuration.setAllowedOrigins(Arrays.asList(allowedOrigins.split(",")));
        configuration.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
        configuration.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("*"));
        configuration.setExposedHeaders(List.of("Authorization"));
        configuration.setAllowCredentials(true);

        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", configuration);
        return source;
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/config/SecurityConfig.java
package com.sportconnect.config;

import com.sportconnect.security.JwtAuthenticationFilter;
import com.sportconnect.security.RateLimitingFilter;
import com.sportconnect.security.RestAccessDeniedHandler;
import com.sportconnect.security.RestAuthenticationEntryPoint;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthenticationFilter;
    private final RateLimitingFilter rateLimitingFilter;
    private final RestAuthenticationEntryPoint restAuthenticationEntryPoint;
    private final RestAccessDeniedHandler restAccessDeniedHandler;
    private final CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource;

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource))
                .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .exceptionHandling(eh -> eh
                        .authenticationEntryPoint(restAuthenticationEntryPoint)
                        .accessDeniedHandler(restAccessDeniedHandler))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                        .requestMatchers("/api/auth/**").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.GET, "/api/events", "/api/events/**").permitAll()
                        .requestMatchers("/actuator/health").permitAll()
                        .anyRequest().authenticated())
                .addFilterBefore(rateLimitingFilter, JwtAuthenticationFilter.class)
                .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthenticationFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);

        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder(10);
    }
}

package com.sportconnect.config;

import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.GeospatialIndex;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.IndexOperations;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.GeoSpatialIndexType;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.index.Index;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class MongoIndexInitializer {

    private final MongoTemplate mongoTemplate;

    @PostConstruct
    public void initIndexes() {
        IndexOperations eventIndexOps = mongoTemplate.indexOps(Event.class);
        eventIndexOps.ensureIndex(
                new GeospatialIndex("location").typed(GeoSpatialIndexType.GEO_2DSPHERE));
        eventIndexOps.ensureIndex(
                new Index().on("sportType", Sort.Direction.ASC).on("startTime", Sort.Direction.ASC));
        eventIndexOps.ensureIndex(new Index().on("organizerId", Sort.Direction.ASC));
        eventIndexOps.ensureIndex(new Index().on("status", Sort.Direction.ASC));

        IndexOperations userIndexOps = mongoTemplate.indexOps(User.class);
        userIndexOps.ensureIndex(new Index().on("email", Sort.Direction.ASC).unique());
    }
}

public class EventMapper {

        LocationDTO location = new LocationDTO(e.getLocation().getY(), e.getLocation().getX());

        return EventDTO.builder()
                .id(e.getId())
                .sportType(e.getSportType().name())
                .title(e.getTitle())
                .description(e.getDescription())
                .location(location)
                .addressLabel(e.getAddressLabel())
                .startTime(e.getStartTime())
                .durationMinutes(e.getDurationMinutes())
                .maxParticipants(e.getMaxParticipants())
                .currentParticipants(e.getParticipantIds().size())
                .participantIds(e.getParticipantIds())
                .organizerId(e.getOrganizerId())
                .status(e.getStatus().name())
                .isOwnedByCurrentUser(currentUserId != null && currentUserId.equals(e.getOrganizerId()))
                .isJoinedByCurrentUser(currentUserId != null && e.getParticipantIds().contains(currentUserId))
                .build();
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/service/SseEmitterRegistry.java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

/**
 * In-memory, per-instance registry of active SSE connections keyed by userId.
 *
 * KNOWN LIMITATION (documented, MVP scope): this registry lives in the JVM heap of a
 * single backend instance. If the backend is scaled horizontally, notifications will
 * only reach users whose connection landed on the instance handling the triggering
 * request. Post-MVP fix: back this with Redis pub/sub for cross-instance fan-out.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
public class SseEmitterRegistry {

    private static final long EMITTER_TIMEOUT_MS = 30L * 60 * 1000; // 30 minutes

    private final Map<String, CopyOnWriteArrayList<SseEmitter>> emittersByUser = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public SseEmitter register(String userId) {
        SseEmitter emitter = new SseEmitter(EMITTER_TIMEOUT_MS);
        emittersByUser.computeIfAbsent(userId, k -> new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>()).add(emitter);

        emitter.onCompletion(() -> remove(userId, emitter));
        emitter.onTimeout(() -> remove(userId, emitter));
        emitter.onError(ex -> remove(userId, emitter));

        try {
            emitter.send(SseEmitter.event().name("heartbeat")
                    .data(Map.of("ts", Instant.now().toString()), MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON));
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            remove(userId, emitter);
        }

        return emitter;
    }

    private void remove(String userId, SseEmitter emitter) {
        CopyOnWriteArrayList<SseEmitter> list = emittersByUser.get(userId);
        if (list != null) {
            list.remove(emitter);
            if (list.isEmpty()) {
                emittersByUser.remove(userId);
            }
        }
    }

    public void sendToUser(String userId, String eventName, Object data) {
        CopyOnWriteArrayList<SseEmitter> list = emittersByUser.get(userId);
        if (list == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (SseEmitter emitter : list) {
            try {
                emitter.send(SseEmitter.event().name(eventName).data(data, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON));
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                remove(userId, emitter);
            }
        }
    }

    public void broadcast(String eventName, Object data, Set<String> excludeUserIds) {
        for (String userId : emittersByUser.keySet()) {
            if (excludeUserIds != null && excludeUserIds.contains(userId)) {
                continue;
            }
            sendToUser(userId, eventName, data);
        }
    }

    @Scheduled(fixedRate = 30000)
    public void heartbeat() {
        Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of("ts", Instant.now().toString());
        for (String userId : emittersByUser.keySet()) {
            sendToUser(userId, "heartbeat", payload);
        }
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/service/NotificationService.java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class NotificationService {

    private final SseEmitterRegistry registry;
    private final UserRepository userRepository;

    /** New game matching interested users' preferred sports. */
    public void notifyNewGame(Event event) {
        List<User> interested = userRepository.findByPreferredSportsContaining(event.getSportType().name());
        Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of(
                "eventId", event.getId(),
                "sportType", event.getSportType().name(),
                "title", event.getTitle()
        );
        for (User u : interested) {
            if (!u.getId().equals(event.getOrganizerId())) {
                registry.sendToUser(u.getId(), "new-game", payload);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Roster changed (join/leave) — notify organizer + all current participants. */
    public void notifyRosterChange(Event event) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of(
                "eventId", event.getId(),
                "currentParticipants", event.getParticipantIds().size(),
                "maxParticipants", event.getMaxParticipants()
        );
        registry.sendToUser(event.getOrganizerId(), "roster-change", payload);
        for (String participantId : event.getParticipantIds()) {
            registry.sendToUser(participantId, "roster-change", payload);
        }
    }

    /** Event cancelled — notify organizer + all participants. */
    public void notifyEventCancelled(Event event) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of("eventId", event.getId());
        registry.sendToUser(event.getOrganizerId(), "event-cancelled", payload);
        for (String participantId : event.getParticipantIds()) {
            registry.sendToUser(participantId, "event-cancelled", payload);
        }
    }

    /** Event starting soon — notify organizer + all participants. */
    public void notifyReminder(Event event) {
        Map<String, Object> payload = Map.of(
                "eventId", event.getId(),
                "title", event.getTitle(),
                "startTime", event.getStartTime().toString()
        );
        registry.sendToUser(event.getOrganizerId(), "event-reminder", payload);
        for (String participantId : event.getParticipantIds()) {
            registry.sendToUser(participantId, "event-reminder", payload);
        }
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/service/AuthService.java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.LoginResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.RegisterResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.auth.UserSummaryDTO;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ConflictException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.UnauthorizedException;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import com.sportconnect.security.JwtService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class AuthService {

    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    private final JwtService jwtService;

    public RegisterResponse register(RegisterRequest req) {
        String normalizedEmail = req.getEmail().trim().toLowerCase();

        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(normalizedEmail)) {
            throw new ConflictException("An account with this email already exists");
        }

        User user = new User();
        user.setEmail(normalizedEmail);
        user.setPasswordHash(passwordEncoder.encode(req.getPassword()));
        user.setDisplayName(req.getDisplayName());
        user.setPreferredSports(new ArrayList<>());
        user.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        user.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        user = userRepository.save(user);

        return new RegisterResponse(user.getId(), user.getEmail(), user.getDisplayName());
    }

    public LoginResponse login(LoginRequest req) {
        String normalizedEmail = req.getEmail().trim().toLowerCase();

        User user = userRepository.findByEmail(normalizedEmail)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new UnauthorizedException("Invalid email or password"));

        if (!passwordEncoder.matches(req.getPassword(), user.getPasswordHash())) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid email or password");
        }

        String token = jwtService.generateToken(user.getId(), user.getEmail());
        UserSummaryDTO summary = new UserSummaryDTO(user.getId(), user.getEmail(), user.getDisplayName());

        return new LoginResponse(token, jwtService.getExpirationSeconds(), summary);
    }
}

package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventCreateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventListResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventUpdateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.exception.BadRequestException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ConflictException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ForbiddenException;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.repository.EventRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.geo.Circle;
import org.springframework.data.geo.Distance;
import org.springframework.data.geo.Metrics;
import org.springframework.data.geo.Point;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.MongoTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.geo.GeoJsonPoint;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Criteria;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.query.Query;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EventService {

    private final EventRepository eventRepository;
    private final MongoTemplate mongoTemplate;
    private final NotificationService notificationService;
    private final EventMapper eventMapper;

    public EventDTO createEvent(String organizerId, EventCreateRequest req) {
        Event event = new Event();
        applyRequest(event, req);
        event.setOrganizerId(organizerId);
        event.setParticipantIds(new ArrayList<>());
        event.setStatus(EventStatus.OPEN);
        event.setReminderSent(false);
        event.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        event = eventRepository.save(event);

        notificationService.notifyNewGame(event);

        return eventMapper.toDTO(event, organizerId);
    }

    public EventListResponse listEvents(SportType sportType, Instant startAfter, Instant startBefore,
                                         Double lat, Double lng, Double radiusKm, String currentUserId) {
        List<Criteria> criteriaList = new ArrayList<>();
        criteriaList.add(Criteria.where("status").ne(EventStatus.CANCELLED));

        if (sportType != null) {
            criteriaList.add(Criteria.where("sportType").is(sportType));
        }

        if (startAfter != null || startBefore != null) {
            Criteria startTimeCriteria = Criteria.where("startTime");
            if (startAfter != null) {
                startTimeCriteria = startTimeCriteria.gte(startAfter);
            }
            if (startBefore != null) {
                startTimeCriteria = startTimeCriteria.lte(startBefore);
            }
            criteriaList.add(startTimeCriteria);
        }

        if (lat != null && lng != null && radiusKm != null) {
            if (radiusKm <= 0) {
                throw new BadRequestException("radiusKm must be greater than 0");
            }
            Circle circle = new Circle(new Point(lng, lat), new Distance(radiusKm, Metrics.KILOMETERS));
            criteriaList.add(Criteria.where("location").withinSphere(circle));
        }

        Query query = new Query();
        if (!criteriaList.isEmpty()) {
            query.addCriteria(new Criteria().andOperator(criteriaList.toArray(new Criteria[0])));
        }

        long total = mongoTemplate.count(query, Event.class);
        query.with(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "startTime"));
        List<Event> events = mongoTemplate.find(query, Event.class);

        List<EventDTO> dtos = events.stream()
                .map(e -> eventMapper.toDTO(e, currentUserId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        return new EventListResponse(dtos, total);
    }

    public EventDTO getEvent(String id, String currentUserId) {
        Event event = findOrThrow(id);
        return eventMapper.toDTO(event, currentUserId);
    }

    public EventDTO updateEvent(String id, String userId, EventUpdateRequest req) {
        Event event = findOrThrow(id);
        requireOwner(event, userId);

        applyRequest(event, req);
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        event = eventRepository.save(event);

        return eventMapper.toDTO(event, userId);
    }

    public void cancelEvent(String id, String userId) {
        Event event = findOrThrow(id);
        requireOwner(event, userId);

        event.setStatus(EventStatus.CANCELLED);
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        eventRepository.save(event);

        notificationService.notifyEventCancelled(event);
    }

    public EventDTO joinEvent(String id, String userId) {
        Event event = findOrThrow(id);

        if (event.getStatus() == EventStatus.CANCELLED || event.getStatus() == EventStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw new ConflictException("This event is not open for joining");
        }
        if (event.getParticipantIds().contains(userId)) {
            throw new ConflictException("You have already joined this event");
        }
        if (event.getParticipantIds().size() >= event.getMaxParticipants()) {
            throw new ConflictException("This event is full");
        }

        event.getParticipantIds().add(userId);
        if (event.getParticipantIds().size() >= event.getMaxParticipants()) {
            event.setStatus(EventStatus.FULL);
        }
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        event = eventRepository.save(event);

        notificationService.notifyRosterChange(event);

        return eventMapper.toDTO(event, userId);
    }

    public EventDTO leaveEvent(String id, String userId) {
        Event event = findOrThrow(id);

        if (!event.getParticipantIds().contains(userId)) {
            throw new BadRequestException("You are not a participant of this event");
        }

        event.getParticipantIds().remove(userId);
        if (event.getStatus() == EventStatus.FULL) {
            event.setStatus(EventStatus.OPEN);
        }
        event.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());
        event = eventRepository.save(event);

        notificationService.notifyRosterChange(event);

        return eventMapper.toDTO(event, userId);
    }

    private void applyRequest(Event event, EventCreateRequest req) {
        event.setSportType(req.getSportType());
        event.setTitle(req.getTitle());
        event.setDescription(req.getDescription());
        event.setLocation(new GeoJsonPoint(req.getLocation().getLng(), req.getLocation().getLat()));
        event.setAddressLabel(req.getAddressLabel());
        event.setStartTime(req.getStartTime());
        event.setDurationMinutes(req.getDurationMinutes());
        event.setMaxParticipants(req.getMaxParticipants());
    }

    private Event findOrThrow(String id) {
        return eventRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("Event not found"));
    }

    private void requireOwner(Event event, String userId) {
        if (!event.getOrganizerId().equals(userId)) {
            throw new ForbiddenException("You are not the organizer of this event");
        }
    }
}
```

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/service/UserService.java
package com.sportconnect.service;

import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventListResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.LocationDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.user.UpdateProfileRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.user.UserDTO;
import com.sportconnect.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;
import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.model.User;
import com.sportconnect.repository.EventRepository;
import com.sportconnect.repository.UserRepository;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.geo.GeoJsonPoint;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class UserService {

    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    private final EventRepository eventRepository;
    private final EventMapper eventMapper;

    public UserDTO getCurrentUser(String userId) {
        User user = findOrThrow(userId);
        return toDTO(user);
    }

    public UserDTO updateProfile(String userId, UpdateProfileRequest req) {
        User user = findOrThrow(userId);

        if (req.getDisplayName() != null) {
            user.setDisplayName(req.getDisplayName());
        }
        if (req.getPreferredSports() != null) {
            user.setPreferredSports(req.getPreferredSports().stream()
                    .map(SportType::name)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList()));
        }
        if (req.getHomeLocation() != null) {
            user.setHomeLocation(new GeoJsonPoint(req.getHomeLocation().getLng(), req.getHomeLocation().getLat()));
        }
        user.setUpdatedAt(Instant.now());

        user = userRepository.save(user);
        return toDTO(user);
    }

    public EventListResponse getOrganizedEvents(String userId) {
        List<Event> events = eventRepository.findByOrganizerId(userId);
        return buildResponse(events, userId);
    }

    public EventListResponse getJoinedEvents(String userId) {
        List<Event> events = eventRepository.findByParticipantIdsContaining(userId);
        return buildResponse(events, userId);
    }

    private EventListResponse buildResponse(List<Event> events, String userId) {
        List<EventDTO> dtos = events.stream()
                .map(e -> eventMapper.toDTO(e, userId))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        return new EventListResponse(dtos, dtos.size());
    }

    private User findOrThrow(String userId) {
        return userRepository.findById(userId)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException("User not found"));
    }

    private UserDTO toDTO(User u) {
        LocationDTO location = u.getHomeLocation() != null
                ? new LocationDTO(u.getHomeLocation().getY(), u.getHomeLocation().getX())
                : null;
        return new UserDTO(u.getId(), u.getEmail(), u.getDisplayName(), u.getPreferredSports(), location);
    }
}

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/scheduler/ReminderScheduler.java
package com.sportconnect.scheduler;

import com.sportconnect.model.Event;
import com.sportconnect.model.EventStatus;
import com.sportconnect.repository.EventRepository;
import com.sportconnect.service.NotificationService;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Every minute, finds events starting within the next 15 minutes that haven't
 * had a reminder sent yet, pushes an SSE "event-reminder" to organizer + participants,
 * and marks them as reminded to avoid duplicate notifications.
 */
@Slf4j
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ReminderScheduler {

    private static final int REMINDER_WINDOW_MINUTES = 15;

    private final EventRepository eventRepository;
    private final NotificationService notificationService;

    @Scheduled(fixedRate = 60000)
    public void sendUpcomingReminders() {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        Instant windowEnd = now.plus(REMINDER_WINDOW_MINUTES, ChronoUnit.MINUTES);

        List<Event> upcoming = new ArrayList<>();
        upcoming.addAll(eventRepository.findByStatusAndStartTimeBetweenAndReminderSentFalse(
                EventStatus.OPEN, now, windowEnd));
        upcoming.addAll(eventRepository.findByStatusAndStartTimeBetweenAndReminderSentFalse(
                EventStatus.FULL, now, windowEnd));

        for (Event event : upcoming) {
            try {
                notificationService.notifyReminder(event);
                event.setReminderSent(true);
                eventRepository.save(event);
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                log.warn("Failed to send reminder for event {}: {}", event.getId(), ex.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.sportconnect.controller;

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/controller/EventController.java
package com.sportconnect.controller;

import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventCreateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventDTO;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventListResponse;
import com.sportconnect.dto.event.EventUpdateRequest;
import com.sportconnect.model.SportType;
import com.sportconnect.security.SecurityUtils;
import com.sportconnect.service.EventService;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

import java.time.Instant;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/events")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class EventController {

    private final EventService eventService;

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<EventDTO> create(@Valid @RequestBody EventCreateRequest req) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        EventDTO created = eventService.createEvent(userId, req);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(created);
    }

    @GetMapping
    public ResponseEntity<EventListResponse> list(
            @RequestParam(required = false) SportType sportType,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Instant startAfter,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Instant startBefore,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Double lat,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Double lng,
            @RequestParam(required = false) Double radiusKm) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId().orElse(null);
        EventListResponse response = eventService.listEvents(
                sportType, startAfter, startBefore, lat, lng, radiusKm, userId);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<EventDTO> get(@PathVariable String id) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId().orElse(null);
        return ResponseEntity.ok(eventService.getEvent(id, userId));
    }

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<EventDTO> update(@PathVariable String id,
                                            @Valid @RequestBody EventUpdateRequest req) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(eventService.updateEvent(id, userId, req));
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Void> delete(@PathVariable String id) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        eventService.cancelEvent(id, userId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/join")
    public ResponseEntity<EventDTO> join(@PathVariable String id) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(eventService.joinEvent(id, userId));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/leave")
    public ResponseEntity<EventDTO> leave(@PathVariable String id) {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        return ResponseEntity.ok(eventService.leaveEvent(id, userId));
    }
}

package com.sportconnect.controller;

import com.sportconnect.security.SecurityUtils;
import com.sportconnect.service.SseEmitterRegistry;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/notifications")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class NotificationController {

    private final SseEmitterRegistry registry;

    @GetMapping(value = "/stream", produces = MediaType.TEXT_EVENT_STREAM_VALUE)
    public SseEmitter stream() {
        String userId = SecurityUtils.requireCurrentUserId();
        return registry.register(userId);
    }
}

```markdown path=backend/README.md
# SportConnect Backend

Spring Boot 3 (Java 17) backend for SportConnect: JWT auth, geo-aware event CRUD,
real-time notifications over SSE, and MongoDB Atlas persistence.

## Run locally

```bash
export MONGODB_URI="mongodb://localhost:27017/sportconnect"
export JWT_SECRET="local-dev-secret-please-change-32bytes+"
mvn spring-boot:run
```

The API is served under `http://localhost:8080/api`.

## Run with Docker

```bash
cp .env.example .env   # fill in real values
docker compose up --build
```

## Architecture notes / known limitations

- **JWT auth**: stateless HS256 tokens. `JwtAuthenticationFilter` never rejects a
  request by itself — invalid/expired/missing tokens simply result in an anonymous
  `SecurityContext`; authorization is enforced per-route in `SecurityConfig` and
  per-resource in the service layer (ownership checks for `PUT`/`DELETE` on events).
- **Roles**: `GUEST` (unauthenticated) and `USER` (authenticated) are the only stored
  roles. `ORGANIZER` is not a persisted role — it's derived per-request by comparing
  the authenticated user's id against `Event.organizerId`.
- **Geo queries**: `Event.location` is `2dsphere`-indexed. Radius search uses
  `$geoWithin`/`$centerSphere` via `Criteria.withinSphere(Circle)` with `Metrics.KILOMETERS`.
- **SSE fan-out (single-instance limitation)**: `SseEmitterRegistry` is an in-memory,
  per-JVM map of `userId -> emitters`. This works correctly for the MVP's single backend
  instance. If the backend is horizontally scaled, a user's SSE connection may land on a
  different instance than the one handling the triggering write, so they would miss that
  notification. **Post-MVP fix**: back this registry with Redis pub/sub so every instance
  fans out to all connected clients regardless of which instance holds the connection.
- **Rate limiting**: Bucket4j in-memory buckets keyed by client IP, applied only to
  `/api/auth/**`. Also single-instance only for the same reason as above; a distributed
  rate limiter (e.g., Redis-backed Bucket4j) is the scaling path.
- **Reminders**: `ReminderScheduler` runs every 60s, looks for `OPEN`/`FULL` events
  starting within 15 minutes with `reminderSent = false`, and pushes an `event-reminder`
  SSE frame to organizer + participants exactly once.

## API contract

See the architecture document for the full contract. All endpoints are under `/api`,
errors follow the standard shape:

```json
{ "timestamp": "ISO8601", "status": 400, "error": "Bad Request", "message": "...", "path": "/api/..." }
```
```

A note on one file above: `JwtService` intentionally overwrites its `key` field once after an unused `Jwts.SIG.HS256.key().build()` call — that first assignment is dead code left from exploring the jjwt API and should be removed; the real key is produced deterministically from `app.jwt.secret` via `Keys(secret)`. Here is the corrected, clean version to use instead of the earlier one:

```java path=backend/src/main/java/com/sportconnect/security/JwtService.java
package com.sportconnect.security;

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims;
import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts;
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import javax.crypto.SecretKey;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Date;

@Component
public class JwtService {

    private final SecretKey key;
    private final long expirationSeconds;

    public JwtService(@Value("${app.jwt.secret}") String secret,
                       @Value("${app.jwt.expiration-seconds}") long expirationSeconds) {
        this.key = buildKey(secret);
        this.expirationSeconds = expirationSeconds;
    }

    private SecretKey buildKey(String secret) {
        byte[] bytes = secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        // HS256 requires a key of at least 256 bits (32 bytes); pad short dev secrets.
        if (bytes.length < 32) {
            byte[] padded = new byte[32];
            System.arraycopy(bytes, 0, padded, 0, bytes.length);
            bytes = padded;
        }
        return Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(bytes);
    }

    public String generateToken(String userId, String email) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();
        return Jwts.builder()
                .subject(userId)
                .claim("email", email)
                .issuedAt(Date.from(now))
                .expiration(Date.from(now.plusSeconds(expirationSeconds)))
                .signWith(key, Jwts.SIG.HS256)
                .compact();
    }

    public Claims parseToken(String token) throws JwtException {
        return Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(key)
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)
                .getPayload();
    }

    public long getExpirationSeconds() {
        return expirationSeconds;
    }
}
```

Use this final version of `JwtService.java` (it replaces the earlier draft in the file listing above).
